description: Cancel a queued or running job. What that stops and refunds depends on the kind — generate_music / render_midi / cover_song: a render not yet on the GPU is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes (credits spent), the job ends as canceled, output discarded. audio_to_session: cooperative — stops at the next stage boundary and refunds the build's sound-tool unit (a separation already run stays charged). bounce_session: a bounce still queued never renders (budget refunded); one mid-render has its result dropped. separate_stems / transcribe / convert_project: no plane-side stop — the work completes (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. The synchronous analyses are already finished (409 already_terminal).

job_id.description: The job_id from a submit tool or doseedo_list_jobs.

name: doseedo_cancel_job
